fresco.interviews.ExportOptionsView.byDe: By default Interviewer exports sociogram node coordinates as normalised X/Y values (a number between 0 and 1 for each axis, with the origin in the top left). Enabling this option will store coordinates as screen space pixel values, with the same origin.
fresco.page.thisTableSummarizesTheMostRe: This table summarises the most recent activity within Fresco. Use it to keep track of new protocols, interviews, and participants.
